meta.title: Admin Pro - Enterprise-Level Admin System Solution

hero.description: Admin Pro is a comprehensive enterprise-grade admin template based on React 18, Vite, Ant Design 5, and Spring Boot 3. It provides a complete solution for building modern, secure, and scalable web applications. Open source and free to use.

features.title: Packed with <1>Awesome</1> Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to build a modern admin application, from frontend to backend.

rbac.title: RBAC Permission
rbac.desc: A robust Role-Based Access Control system supporting dynamic menu generation, button-level permissions, and API security integration.

codegen.title: Code Generator
codegen.desc: Instantly generate full-stack CRUD code (Controller, Service, Mapper, React Components) from your database schema, saving 80% of development time.

docker.title: Docker Support
docker.desc: Complete Docker and Docker Compose configuration for one-click deployment. Includes optimized multi-stage builds for both frontend and backend.

monitor.title: Monitor & Logs
monitor.desc: Integrated system monitoring dashboard, real-time operation logs, and login audit trails to ensure system security and observability.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.desc: Built-in multi-language support using i18next. Easily switch between English and Chinese, with a scalable structure for adding more languages.

responsive.title: Responsive Design
responsive.desc: Meticulously crafted responsive layout ensuring a seamless experience across all devices, from large desktop monitors to mobile phones.
